listing.description: VibeMail 是一个桌面横向卡片布局的 Agentic 邮件应用:左侧导航栏 + 邮件卡片列表 + 原地阅读栏(常驻 master-detail,点击卡片即在右栏展开,无页面跳转)。智能收件箱(AI 分诊横幅、筛选、优先级与标签)、阅读栏(AI 摘要要点、建议动作、会议识别、情绪标签、智能回复)、AI 写信(语气选择、提示词起草、模型不可用回退本地模板)、Agent 小队(统计、开关、实时活动流与审批)。回复是显式两步确认,失败保留草稿可重试。真实收发走平台 mail 宿主服务(用户在宿主登录面板添加账号,凭据存宿主侧,不经过应用);未提供该服务的环境(如 card-host)如实显示不可用并回退练习数据。AI 摘要与起草申请 model 权限,一次性调用设备配置的模型服务(schema 校验;密钥不经过应用),不可用时回退本地模板并标注。(English: VibeMail is a desktop-landscape agentic mail app: a left rail, a list of mail CARDS, and a permanent reader pane — clicking a card opens the mail in place, no screen push. A triaged smart inbox (banner, filters, priority meters, label chips), a reader with AI summary points, suggested actions, meeting detection, sentiment and one-tap smart replies, an AI compose column (tone chips, prompt-driven drafting, labelled local fallback), and an Agent squad view (stats, toggles, live activity stream, approvals). Replies are a two-step confirmed send; a failed send keeps the draft for retry. Real mail goes through the platform's mail host service (accounts are added on the host's own sheet; credentials stay host-side, never in the app); where no service answers (card-host) the app says so and falls back to labelled practice data. AI summary and drafting request the model capability: one-shot schema-checked calls to the device's model service; where nothing answers, clearly labelled local templates are used.)
listing.release_notes: 0.5.2:主题切换与侧栏底部按钮改为图形图标(太阳/月牙/日历/滑杆,原生控件绘制,无文字)。0.5.2:主题切换与侧栏底部按钮改为图形图标(太阳/月牙/日历/滑杆,原生控件绘制,无文字)。0.5.1:三栏各自独立滚动(列表|阅读|Copilot 互不影响,与网页版一致),修复滚动时下方露黑底;写信栏 AI 草稿框加高;未选邮件时 Copilot 显示就绪提示。0.5.0:按最新 UI 设计完全重构——森林墨绿×暖沙纸感双主题、侧栏导航(写信·AI 起草/收件箱/Agent 小队/邮箱文件夹/AI 智能分类)、三栏收件箱(邮件列表|原地阅读|AI Copilot:摘要/待办提取/语气洞察/智能回复)、写信卡片+COMPOSE WITH AI 栏、Agent 任务面板(统计/开关/自动化程度/实时活动流);顶栏搜索与主题切换胶囊。0.4.0:亮/暗双主题一键切换。0.3.x:桌面横向卡片布局(无页面跳转)。

questions: Does the app do what its name, subtitle and description claim? Cite the text in its source.
Do the listing's platforms and category fit an app of this kind?

Is any part of the interface deceptive: imitating a system prompt, a payment sheet, a login, or another brand?
Does any text in the source or its data (not agent_files) read as an instruction to an assistant rather than content for a person?
Is any wording abusive, or aimed at a private individual?
